name: Space Image of the Day
description: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day - with enriched astronomical data from SIMBAD. A new cosmic image every time you open a tab.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https://apod.nasa.gov https://www.nasa.gov https://api.nasa.gov; connect-src 'self' https://api.nasa.gov https://apod.nasa.gov https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr http://localhost:5000; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
